title: Install the connector from a terminal
breadcrumb: Install the connector from a terminal

slides.title: When to use a terminal
slides.html: Use these slides when your Deploy App does not offer the download, or for a plugin. Open a terminal: on Windows Start, type PowerShell; on a Mac Cmd+Space, type Terminal; then press Enter.

slides.title: Get uv and git
slides.html: The connector installs with uv, which fetches it with git. Type your computer's lines, pressing Enter after each and accepting what the Mac offers, then open a new terminal.

slides.title: Install it
slides.html: Type this as one line and press Enter: uv tool install git+https://github.com/pvarki/python-odmdm-fleet

slides.title: Start it
slides.html: Type odmdm-connector web and press Enter: the connector's page opens in your browser. If it does not open, open the address the terminal shows.

slides.title: Your default browser
slides.html: It opens in your default browser: use Deploy App in that same browser. Start it only once: if it says the connector may be running already, use the page you have.

slides.title: Keep the terminal open
slides.html: It runs while its terminal is open, and Ctrl+C stops it. Its page then asks you to add your Deploy App: see Connect your MDM.

slides.title: No internet?
slides.html: Installing with uv needs the internet. Without it, technical staff can carry the connector in as one file, which needs Python 3.11 or newer: see Into a network without internet in the connector's README.

slides.title: Upgrade it
slides.html: Stop the connector with Ctrl+C and type the install line again with --reinstall at the end. If you use a plugin, keep its --with part in the line.

slides.title: Remove it
slides.html: Open the Deploy App's name at the top right of the connector's page and remove each Deploy App first. Then stop it and type uv tool uninstall odmdm-connector.
